breeding.title: Breeding and lambing
breeding.description: Pregnancies, lambing calendar, breeding results and pedigree

pregnancies.addHint: The expected lambing date is calculated automatically.
pregnancies.bulkHint: Records every ewe in the herd with the same date. Ewes already pregnant are skipped.
pregnancies.bulkInbreeding_one: {{count}} ewe is related to the ram, please check
pregnancies.bulkInbreeding_other: {{count}} ewes are related to the ram, please check
pregnancies.closeHint: Choose the outcome. The ewe returns to active.
pregnancies.deleteBody: The record for ewe {{tag}} will be removed. Use this only for a record entered by mistake.
pregnancies.editHint: Changing the date recalculates the lambing date.
pregnancies.emptyBody: Add a pregnancy, or record a whole herd at once.
pregnancies.inbreedingBody: This ewe and ram share an ancestor: {{tags}}. You can still save, but please check.

calendar.byWeekHint: How many ewes are due each week. Plan feed and labour around it.
calendar.empty: No lambing expected in the next 6 months
calendar.overdueHint: Past the latest date with no lambing recorded

lambing.needSex: Choose the sex of each lamb
lambing.emptyBody: The first lambing will appear here.

kpis.emptyBody: Each ewe's results appear here once lambings are recorded.

rams.explain: Rams are rated by how fast their lambs grow. 100 is the farm average; 110 is 10% faster than average.
rams.emptyBody: The rating appears once rams are registered and their lambs weighed.

pedigree.truncated: There are many descendants; showing the first 200.
pedigree.emptyBody: Find an animal by its tag and its pedigree appears here.

health.title: Veterinary
health.description: Vaccination, treatment, quarantine and withdrawal periods

today.allClearBody: No sick reports and no overdue vaccinations.

journal.warehouseHint: Leave empty to use the drug's main warehouse
journal.qtyUsedHint: Leave empty to use dose × head × days
journal.withdrawalHint: Leave empty to use the drug's default
journal.headCountHint: Leave empty to use the herd size
journal.editStockNote: Saving recalculates what was taken from stock.
journal.emptyBody: Vaccinations, treatments and examinations are kept here.

vaccinations.vaccineHint: Leave empty to use the plan's vaccine
vaccinations.qtyHint: Leave empty to use dose × head count
vaccinations.head: Head
vaccinations.emptyBody: Everything is up to date for this period.

plans.title: Vaccination plans
plans.hint: A plan works out when vaccination is due from age and interval.
plans.name: Name
plans.itemHint: Records using this vaccine count towards the plan
plans.deleteBody: "{{name}}" leaves the calendar. Past records are kept.
plans.emptyBody: Add the mandatory vaccinations and the calendar builds itself.

quarantine.addHint: For newly arrived or sick animals.
quarantine.daysHint: Leave empty to use the farm setting
quarantine.emptyBody: Put new or sick animals into quarantine here.

withdrawal.explain: Meat and milk from these animals cannot be sold before the date shown.
withdrawal.emptyBody: An animal given a drug with a withdrawal period appears here.

sick.reportHint: The vet is told straight away.
sick.unreportedHint: Marked as sick on the animal card.
sick.resolveHint: The report closes and the animal returns to its earlier status.

documents.name: Name
documents.emptyBody: Veterinary and quarantine certificates are kept here.
